overall_goal: Fry a potato chicken ball and wrap the remaining uncooked balls for storage.

goals.description: Fry and turn the potato chicken balls.
goals.rationale: The person places a potato chicken ball into the hot oil and uses a skimmer to turn the frying balls.

goals.description: Prepare cling film and inspect the potato chicken balls.
goals.rationale: The person rolls out and tears off a sheet of cling film, then inspects the uncooked potato chicken balls to decide which to fry and which to store.

goals.description: Wrap the potato chicken balls in cling film.
goals.rationale: The person places multiple uncooked potato chicken balls onto the prepared cling film and wraps them up.

goals.description: Clean up residual flour and crumbs from the foil.
goals.rationale: The person lifts the foil to collect the leftover flour and crumbs, then empties them into a bowl.

goals.description: Wrap the last potato chicken ball in cling film.
goals.rationale: The person pulls out more cling film to wrap the final uncooked potato chicken ball.

goals.description: Wrap the cling-film-wrapped potato chicken balls in foil.
goals.rationale: The person takes the potato chicken balls that were already wrapped in cling film and wraps them again in aluminum foil.

goals.description: Remove the fried potato chicken ball and reposition the pan.
goals.rationale: The person uses the skimmer to lift the cooked potato chicken ball out of the oil, places it in a bowl, and moves the hot pan.

goals.description: Store the wrapped potato chicken balls in a tupperware.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a tupperware container and places the foil-wrapped potato chicken balls inside it.

goals.description: Wrap the tupperware in cling film.
goals.rationale: The person stores the cling film roll, then uses a packet of cling film to wrap the tupperware containing the potato chicken balls.
